title: habenaria densiflora
intro: Habenaria densiflora, commonly known as the Dense-flowered Habenaria or the Korean orchid, is a species of orchid in the family Orchidaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Habenaria densiflora include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
